scenarios.name: Bog'chada yangi do'st
scenarios.goal: Bola yangi do'sti bilan tanishadi: ismini so'raydi, o'z ismini aytadi va hol so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha bog'chada yangi do'st ko'rdi. Keling, [en]What's your name?[/en] deb tanishamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Look! A new friend! Let's say hello and ask: What's your name?

scene.image_prompt: Two small children meeting in a bright kindergarten classroom, one waving hello to the other, toys and a rug around them, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: You want to know your friend's name. What do you say?

questions.q: Do'stingiz [en]How are you?[/en] dedi. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: Your friend asks: How are you? What do you say?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]I'm fine, thank you![/en] — yaxshiman, rahmat.
questions.why_en: Good job! I'm fine, thank you!

questions.q_en: Say your name!

scenarios.name: Rasm darsida kamalak chizamiz
scenarios.goal: Bola rasm darsida ranglarni inglizcha aytadi va «What colour is it?» savoliga javob beradi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha kamalakni juda yaxshi ko'radi. Tarbiyachi so'raydi: [en]What colour is it?[/en] Keling, javob beramiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Let's paint a rainbow! What colour is it?

scene.image_prompt: A small child painting a big rainbow on paper at a classroom easel while a smiling teacher points at the colors, paint pots around, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q: Tarbiyachi pushti bo'yoqni ko'rsatdi: [en]What colour is it?[/en]
questions.q_en: The teacher shows pink paint. What colour is it?
How do you ask about a colour?
questions.why: Barakalla! [en]What colour is it?[/en] — bu qanday rang?
questions.why_en: Good job! What colour is it?

scenarios.name: Parkda o'rdaklarni sanaymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola parkda o'rdaklarni sanaydi va «How many?» savoliga javob beradi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha bilan parkka boramiz. Ko'lda o'rdaklar suzyapti — [en]How many?[/en] Keling, sanaymiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We are at the park. Look at the ducks! How many ducks?

scene.image_prompt: A dad and a small child standing by a pond in a green park, counting six little ducks swimming, trees and flowers, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q: Nechta ekanini so'rash uchun nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: How do you ask about a number?
There are six ducks. How many?
Count ten fingers!

scenarios.name: Buvijon bilan hayvonot bog'ida
scenarios.goal: Bola hayvonot bog'ida yovvoyi hayvonlarni ko'rib, ularni inglizcha nomlaydi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha buvijon bilan hayvonot bog'iga keldi. U yerda [en]lion[/en] va [en]monkey[/en] bor. Keling, ko'ramiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We are at the zoo with Granny. Look! A lion and a monkey!

scene.image_prompt: A grandmother holding hands with a small child at a friendly zoo, a big smiling lion and a playful monkey in a tree nearby, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: You see a lion. What do you say?
A monkey is in the tree. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Buvijonnikiga mehmonga boramiz
scenarios.goal: Bola buvisi bilan salomlashadi va o'z oila a'zosini tanishtiradi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha bilan buvijonnikiga mehmonga boramiz. Singlimizni [en]This is my sister.[/en] deb tanishtiramiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We are visiting Grandma! Let's say hello: This is my sister.

scene.image_prompt: A small boy and his little sister arriving at grandma's cozy house, grandma smiling and opening her arms at the door, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: I'm fine! This is my sister.

questions.q_en: You see Grandma. What do you say?
Show your brother to Grandma!
questions.why_en: Good job! This is my brother.

questions.q_en: Grandma asks: How are you? What do you say?

scenarios.name: Bog'chada ertalabki badantarbiya
scenarios.goal: Bola tarbiyachining inglizcha buyruqlarini bajaradi va tana a'zolarini ko'rsatadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha ertalab badantarbiya qiladi. Tarbiyachi aytadi: [en]Clap your hands![/en] Tayyormisiz?
scenarios.intro_en: Good morning! Let's do morning exercises. Clap your hands!

scene.image_prompt: Happy kindergarten children doing morning exercises on a mat, clapping hands and touching their noses, a smiling teacher showing the moves, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q_en: The teacher says: Stamp your feet! What do you do?
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]Stamp your feet![/en] — oyog'ingni tap-tap qil.

questions.q_en: Touch your nose! What is it?

scenarios.name: Bozorda meva olamiz
scenarios.goal: Bola bozorda kerakli mevani sonini aytib odob bilan so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha onajon bilan bozorga keldi. Sotuvchidan [en]Five apples, please.[/en] deb so'raymiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We are at the market. Let's ask: Five apples, please.

scene.image_prompt: A friendly seller at a colorful market stall with apples, bananas, oranges and carrots, handing a bag of apples to a small child, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q: Sizga uchta banan kerak. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: You want three bananas. What do you say?
The seller gives you the fruit. What do you say?

questions.q: Siz olmani yaxshi ko'rasiz. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: You like apples. What do you say?
questions.why: Zo'r! [en]I like apples![/en] — men olmani yaxshi ko'raman.

scenarios.name: Parkka borishga kiyinamiz
scenarios.goal: Bola parkka chiqishdan oldin kiyimlarini inglizcha aytib kiyinadi
scenarios.intro: Gu-gu! Kabutar qushcha bilan parkka boramiz. Avval kiyinamiz: [en]hat[/en], [en]shoes[/en] — va varrakni olamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: Let's go to the park! Put on your hat and shoes!

scene.image_prompt: A mum helping a small child put on a red hat and shoes by the front door, a colorful kite leaning on the wall, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

questions.q: Onam: [en]Put on your hat![/en] Nimani kiyasiz?
questions.q_en: Mum says: Put on your hat! What do you put on?
What do you take to the park? Show the kite!
